primary_endpoint: Participants with improvement in NAFLD activity by standardized liver biopsy scoring from baseline to 96 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Improvement occurred in 27 participants on pioglitazone, 36 on vitamin E, and 16 on placebo; reported Mantel-Haenszel p-values were 0.001 and 0.04.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 2/80 participants on pioglitazone, 7/84 on vitamin E, and 10/83 on placebo; deaths were not reported.
